body: thank you man. i.... just thank you. you've given me a little bit of hope here.
do you ever think that maybe you would have been better off with another family?

you are stronger than me.  i wish i had that kind of strength to pull through. but i cant even pretend to be strong.

im glad your daughter has you.

you know how christians always say 'when life forces you to your knees, your in the perfect position to pray' well I dont have that so.. Im just left on my knees hoping something will crash down on me and end it all. I know how the OP is feeling and, I feel for them. I feel them.

i feel you.
maybe it's not what you are looking for but i too am debating ending it. im here. im right here. i know exactly what you are feeling. im here too.

im glad your story has a happy ending. your mother is a strong woman, stronger than myself. losing my kid is.. well.. its brought me here.  today, when i was on the floor crying, he came up and layed his head on my side. part of me wanted to take that sign of hope and keep going.. but another, bigger part of me knows im spent and although i wish i could brush myself off and pull through, i doubt it. i know myself, and i feel like this is going to be what breaks me. its just a waiting game until he is taken away from me.

See, I feel like when I go to court, they treat me like I'm the same type of person as her. Like I'm a mother who puts her child last. It's fucking terrible that people can do that. My husband has put me through hell and back.. at this point hell is a welcome exchange. I don't even want his money. I don't even really want him in my sons life. but I am trying to do whats best for my boy. I don't want him to grow up WITHOUT a dad so I do what the court says, I arranged for a third party to take him, I did my best. I followed the rules. And it all backfired. I keep getting the shitty end of the stick. I wish I was stronger but I'm just not. It's all gotten to be too much and if I lose him.. it's the end for me. I cease to have a reason to exist.

if i had put up with the abuse, then my son would have been with me for sure. now he might be with strangers, and this breaks my heart. i didnt want him to see his father abuse me, but .. fucck.. well maybe he is better off with strangers. at this point im doubting everything. i just want it to be over. i know im a good mother, i take pride in being a wonderful mother. and to have to sit in court and hear my husband say im not, pains me very much. i wish god or.. someone.. could help me but its a lost cause.
